title: Jude and the Asset
author: Astrid Marchetti
blurb: Xanthe Nakamura, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
